reason: The plugin is primarily an integration bridge that helps local DSH environments load and run Pi Coding Agent extensions by adapting their tools, commands, resources, and lifecycle into native DSH host/client behavior, with explicit emphasis on preserving terminal-style UI rendering in the web client, per repository and README evidence.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek DSH 插件兼容桥接层，用于把 Pi Coding Agent 扩展的工具、命令与终端界面适配到 DSH 中。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek DSH compatibility bridge plugin that adapts Pi Coding Agent tools, commands, and terminal-style UI behavior for use inside DSH.

capabilities: Adapts Pi Coding Agent extensions and runtime resources into DeepSeek DSH sessions.
Bridges tool, command, and lifecycle interfaces between Pi-style extensions and DSH host/client surfaces.
Renders Pi-style terminal UI frames, overlays, and input behavior in the DSH web client.
Converts host-client messages and model/thinking/session state between the two systems for compatibility.

reasons.code: README describes the project as a TypeScript compatibility bridge for running Pi Coding Agent extensions and Pi-style terminal UI inside DeepSeek DSH.
Architecture section lists host modules for runtime adaptation, message conversion, UI protocol, resource/tool/command adapters, lifecycle hooks, and a web client terminal UI surface.
package.json marks DSH plugin entry points (`.` -> `lib/index.js`, `./client` -> `lib/client.js`) and includes DSH web client/runtime injections.
Repository topics and description explicitly position it as a DSH plugin bridge for Pi Coding Agent integration.
